decision_basis: Segraves & Pellmyr 2001 / later community study state that T. maculata is monophagous on the exclusive host H. whipplei, but only eight directly sampled populations were confirmed under the prospective v7.3 admission audit; no extra site was geocoded or added to rescue the 10-site floor.

CROT001 originally passed the response-blind literature freeze, but subsequent adversarial interaction review found C. rotundiventris larvae on T. altaicus and T. asiaticus, both predeclared replacement hosts. The species-level exclusive dependency scope and control pool are therefore invalid. Snapshot taxonomy identity and occurrence were never opened; no controls or dependency scope were rescued.

Hopper 2019 provides ten prospectively unambiguous single-coordinate N. eichhorniae-positive populations after excluding the N. eichhorniae-negative SAE row and the composite two-locality CA row. Center 2010 and Tran et al. 2021 support water hyacinth as the sole plant supporting full reproduction/life-cycle completion. Current GBIF taxonomy directly accepts N. eichhorniae but treats Eichhornia crassipes as nonaccepted; a direct synonym bridge to the predeclared accepted name Pontederia crassipes is required before any snapshot identity access. Human releases and N. bruchi hybridization permanently keep the pair engineering-only.
